name: Bug report

## Environment
App version, Homey model/firmware, luminaire model, Casambi firmware generation.

## Steps and expected/actual behavior

## Safe diagnostics
Include only sanitized event/phase names. Never upload network exports, keys,
passwords, BLE addresses, tokens, full packets or raw Homey diagnostic archives.

## Recovery
Does reconnecting restore confirmed state? Were other clients using Bluetooth?
